title: [NSW] Recommendation for Landlord Insurance 2026
body:
Wondering if people had recommendation of landlord insurers especially if you had experience in making claims.
Update:
Some quotes for same property:
Terri Sheer: $907
Aldi Insurance: 502
PIP: 450
NRMA: $686 for $1000 excess
EBM RentCover: Don't cover for self managed
I wanted to Terri Sheer but not sure why their quote is double compared to others. Also, not sure if others are dud policies where when its time to make a claim, they don't cover it. Usually the discrepency is not that high.
